properties.name: CORRECTING A BASELINE THAT WAS INVENTED RATHER THAN COMPUTED. The first link carried a hand-typed hash that had never been read off the file — a plausible-looking string in the one field whose entire job is to be unforgeable. Nothing about the file or the design changed between the two values; only the recorded hash became true. Worth keeping on the record: a checksum nobody computed is worse than none, because reconcile_artifacts would have reported drift forever against a baseline that never described anything.
